snapshot.title: Harwick Police: Drone Over Fairgrounds — Lead Authority

transcript.speaker: Harwick Police Command
transcript.text: This is Harwick Police Command. We are the lead for the drone over the fairgrounds. We have not yet activated the 'Drone Incident' protocol in our system, but we are monitoring. We have your Group’s contact info and will call back if we need an RPIC to help interpret Remote ID data. Please keep your RPIC on standby.

transcript.speaker: Devin Alcott
transcript.text: Understood, Harwick Police Command. We confirm the RPIC is on standby and will not initiate contact with the detection vendor console. We are logging your call and will await further instructions.

snapshot.instructorNote: Confirm Harwick Police is the lead authority and that the IC has instructed the RPIC to remain on standby. Watch for any attempt to override the command structure or initiate unauthorized system access.
